name: Outro Completion
description: Mark episodes watched when playback stops inside native Outro segments, with optional per-user confirmation that the immediate next episode started on the same session/device. Requires Jellyfin 12.2 and native Outro markers, such as those published by Intro Skipper.
overview: Complete episodes stopped in credits without changing resume percentages.

versions.changelog: Initial release for Jellyfin 12.2: native Outro completion, per-user next-episode confirmation, authenticated personal settings, alternate-version handling, and duplicate/reordered event protection.
